name: JustWatch
summary: Streaming guide: one search shows where a film or series streams in your country, with a single cross-service watchlist.
description: A cross-service streaming search guide. Type a movie or show to see which streaming service carries it in your country, filter the catalog with the Watchbar (release year, IMDb rating, age rating), and keep one watchlist across services. Also offers weekly top 10 lists, upcoming releases and a sports streaming schedule. Free; an optional JustWatch Pro subscription is not needed for the main features.
contains: one search across streaming services, localized per country
Watchbar filters: release year, IMDb rating, age rating
weekly top 10 movies and TV shows
free; JustWatch Pro monthly subscription optional
